_readme: Runtime configuration, read by the browser at startup. Not compiled into the bundle:
a deploy overwrites this file rather than rebuilding the app.
authMode 'preview' runs in-memory accounts so the app can be walked without a backend.
It is refused unless the page is served from localhost. Switch to 'supabase' and paste
the URL + anon key printed by `supabase start` to sign in for real.
